Wes (@wmorrill3) has been sharing recent Cybertruck advancements and posting more daily.

Today’s update: The Cybertruck can now charge at a 500kW peak rate, with reduced charging time and other quality-of-ownership improvements.

Tesla's cutting edge vehicle continues to improve


Wes (@wmorrill3)

In-house 4680 cells got better, several times actually. And the firmware controls improved as well - both  enabled faster Supercharging. Hitting 500kW peak and more importantly shrinking the 10% to 80% charge times by several minutes.

Not to mention every efficiency improvement I've mentioned also effectively increased charging speed when measured as what matters on a road trip: miles recovered per minute
